item.title: Emergency Failure in the Silver Bullet
item.description: An unexpected mechanical failure brings the Silver Bullet to a halt, turning an ordinary day into an urgent repair mission. Follow the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair process as the team works to identify the problem, get the vehicle back on the road, and overcome the challenges of an emergency breakdown.
